notes: Versions come from the fixed 3.7.1 images; REST reports the full artifact version 3.5.0.69fa31 at runtime, while the distro manifest says 3.5.0. Smoke tests check the exact runtime versions.
MariaDB uses a pinned 10.11 maintenance release; compatibility is checked by fresh startup and persistence tests.

Backend is derived from the fixed 3.7.1 release: large demo content and its generator are removed, base reference metadata is kept, and one synthetic login/facility/visit location is loaded with Initializer.
Upstream moving no-demo tags were not used because inspection showed snapshot components. Vietnamese clinical metadata is not implemented yet.
